# MDL409 · `non-ascii-option-value`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A string option's value contains non-ASCII characters.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | options |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | goption: g_locale_to_utf8 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl409-non-ascii-value-c-locale`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl409-non-ascii-value-c-locale.txtar), [`mdl409-non-ascii-callback-value-c-locale`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl409-non-ascii-callback-value-c-locale.txtar) |

## Why

GLib converts the values of string options (and of most callback options) from the character set of mydumper's locale. Without a UTF-8 locale, which is the case when LANG is unset (cron jobs, the official Docker image), any byte above 127 fails the conversion and mydumper aborts at startup with `Invalid byte sequence in conversion input`. It is a warning because it depends on how mydumper is run; a value that is not valid UTF-8 fails in every locale (error). Filename options such as `outputdir` are not converted.

For an option whose value is optional, such as `compress`, the failed conversion does not abort: the option silently receives no value.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```text
[mydumper]
database=caf\xc3\xa9
regex=^caf\xe9
compress=gz\xc3\xafp
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

```text
2:10-2:14 warning MDL409[non-ascii-option-value] the value of `database` contains non-ASCII characters: GLib converts it from the locale's character set
  = Where the conversion fails (without a UTF-8 locale, e.g. LANG unset in cron or Docker), mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Invalid byte sequence in conversion input, try --help".
3:7-3:12 error MDL409[non-ascii-option-value] the value of `regex` is not valid UTF-8: GLib rejects it in the C locale and in UTF-8 locales
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Invalid byte sequence in conversion input, try --help".
4:10-4:14 warning MDL409[non-ascii-option-value] the value of `compress` contains non-ASCII characters: GLib converts it from the locale's character set
  = Where the conversion fails, `compress` receives no value at all.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL409: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL409` on the line above it.
